intro.title: The Common Grounds Media Matrix
intro.text: A smooth, slide-based presentation comparing the two countries. It charts shared seafaring history, culinary crossovers and language links, and also covers family, faith, dress, crafts, architecture, music, celebrations and people.

ui.hint: Swipe, scroll or use the arrow keys

slides.title: Forts and Sacred Waters
slides.text: Both nations guard fortresses by the sea: the Ribat of Monastir (built in 796) and the Kasbah of Hammamet in Tunisia, Qal'at al-Bahrain and Arad Fort in Bahrain. Ancient temples honoured water: Bahrain's Barbar Temple was built over a sacred spring, and the Roman water temple of Zaghouan celebrates the spring that fed Carthage.
